findings.summary: AssessExperiment initializes PrimaryPassed and GuardrailsPassed to true and never clears them when a preregistered primary or guardrail metric is absent from outcome.Effects, so those booleans can read true while Eligible is false solely due to missing-effect Reasons.
evidence: Lines 103–145 only set PrimaryPassed/GuardrailsPassed false on inconclusive present effects; the missing-metric loop appends Reasons without updating the booleans, yet Eligible requires both flags and empty Reasons.

Missing gate: go test ./internal/optimization -run 'TestAssessExperimentClearsPassFlagsWhenEffectsMissing' (no such test; TestAssessExperimentRequiresPrimaryGuardrailsAndSample and TestAssessExperimentRejectsUnregisteredAndUnderpoweredEvidence never assert PrimaryPassed/GuardrailsPassed under missing effects).

findings.summary: When a present primary effect fails the preregistered MinimumSampleSize, AssessExperiment records a Reason but leaves PrimaryPassed true, so PrimaryPassed does not track the doc rule that sample must pass for primary success toward eligibility.
evidence: Sample failure only appends Reasons at lines 116–118 and never assigns PrimaryPassed=false; Eligible then fails only via len(Reasons)!=0.

docs/architecture/ADVISORY-OPTIMIZATION.md:143–144 states eligibility requires sample, primary, and every guardrail to pass; go test ./internal/optimization -run TestAssessExperimentRejectsUnregisteredAndUnderpoweredEvidence asserts Eligible/Reasons but not PrimaryPassed==false.

findings.summary: resolve-evaluators persists EvaluatorResolution dispositions but neither the CLI nor internal/optimization recomputes EvaluatorMetric against batch dispositions merged with that resolution, so post-resolution precision/FDR/recall/unique-yield cannot be reproduced from stored artifacts via MeasureEvaluatorBatch.
evidence: go test ./cmd/platform-optimizer -run TestRecordEvaluatorsPersistsCalibratedBatch loads the resolution but never remeasures metrics; go test ./internal/optimization -run TestEvaluatorResolutionOnlyAmendsUnresolvedFindings likewise omits post-resolution MeasureEvaluatorBatch.

resolve-evaluators returns only the resolution document after SaveResolution; MeasureEvaluatorBatch reads solely batch.Dispositions and no ApplyResolution/merge helper exists under internal/optimization.
